delivery.attack: Shout one sharp explosive martial-arts kiai during a forceful strike. High projected pitch, fierce effort, hard consonant onset, one breath, sudden cutoff. Never narrate or calmly pronounce the word. Keep the voiced burst compact, about half a second.
delivery.heavy: Shout an intense, high-pitched full-body effort cry at the instant of a powerful finishing strike. An abrupt explosive onset with diaphragm support and gritty vocal pressure, then cut off sharply. One forceful breath, well under a second; not a sustained singing note, not conversational speech.
delivery.hurt: A sudden painful combat impact makes this adult warrior involuntarily cry out: a sharp high-pitched pained yelp, a strained voiced burst followed by an abrupt breath cutoff. Clearly hurt and shocked, muscular tension, intense but brief. Not a sigh, whisper, gentle moan or spoken narration. Shout the short exclamation with a forceful rising onset and broken cutoff.
delivery.special: Shout this Japanese battle cry with explosive heroic fighting-game intensity. High projection, fierce urgency, rising energy with a strongly accented final syllable. A single compact breath, no calm recitation, no extra words, no singing.

oichi.voice_description: An adult Japanese female warrior with a bright clear strong upper-register voice, athletic breath support and a slightly raw edge under effort. Fearless, forceful and battle-ready; never soft, coy or breathy.

boss_mori.voice_description: A fierce adult Japanese male samurai commander, resonant rugged baritone with a strong bright cutting upper edge when shouting. Confident and imposing, explosive breath support, rough combat effort rather than a calm announcer.
